scope: train-only strong video-mask teacher information ceiling; heldout dancetrack0012 only; no dev/gate frames
question: Does propagated foreground identity resolve clean adjacent box-crossing ambiguity that box/feature association could not?

teacher.runtime_role: training-time information teacher only; not a deployment dependency
teacher.seed: oracle-clean previous RT-DETR owner proposal box, restored to source pixels
teacher.proposal_score: IoU between propagated binary foreground mask and each filled current proposal box; argmax; no threshold sweep

sampling.hard: last-clean-box IoU winner wrong, true owner present in top-8; evenly spaced up to 96
sampling.safe: last-clean-box IoU winner correct with IoU margin <= 0.1; evenly spaced up to 96

criteria.screen_rule: weak only if a 95% Wilson upper bound is below a full-test bar; strong screen if point hard>=0.55 and safe>=0.97; otherwise inconclusive and expand before deciding
